# Source

Unmodified copy of `tests/valid/`, `tests/files-toml-1.1.0` and `LICENSE` from
[toml-lang/toml-test](https://github.com/toml-lang/toml-test) (formerly BurntSushi/toml-test),
tag v2.2.0, commit `ce08da1ddb075d1c7596d663c7fcba9a2ae02c5c`, under the MIT licence in `LICENSE`.
To update, download `https://github.com/toml-lang/toml-test/archive/<commit>.tar.gz` and copy the same paths over these.
